label: Roof and envelope insulation upgrade
source_ref: Mohamed, Gomaa & Sarhan (2026), HBRC Journal 22(1), article 41, p.11 sec.7: thermal insulation gives 11.13-16% of total building load in a Mediterranean climate, which supports 18% of the HVAC end use. HBRC Egyptian Energy Building Code (2022) for the baseline; XPS foam market rates, Egypt 2024, for cost.
notes: Fraction is of HVAC end use not of total consumption

label: Double glazing retrofit
source_ref: ASHRAE Handbook-Fundamentals (2021), ch.15 "Fenestration", for the U-factor and SHGC basis of the 8% saving. Saadatian, Freire & Simoes (2021), Journal of Building Engineering 35:102042, sec.3.1, for the 95 kgCO2e/m2 embodied figure (aluminium framing is 60-80% of a double-glazed unit). Alumil / Technal Egypt price lists (2024) for cost.
notes: Composes multiplicatively with insulation - both act on HVAC load

label: High-efficiency HVAC plant replacement
source_ref: IEA, "The Future of Cooling" (2018), Key Findings: the average air conditioner sold today is less than half as efficient as what is typically available and a third of best available technology, so 30% from replacing an aged unit is conservative. Inverter split premium from Egyptian market pricing, 2024.
notes: Raises COP; insulation cuts load; compose multiplicatively

label: BMS zone controls and scheduling
source_ref: PNNL-25985 (2017, rev. October 2017), "Impacts of Commercial Building Controls on Energy Savings and Peak Load Reduction", U.S. DOE Building Technologies Office: up to 30% of building energy is avoidable through better use of existing and advanced controls. 12% is the low end of that range.
notes: Low capex high density - expect this to dominate on savings per EGP

label: LED lighting upgrade
source_ref: Elsewedy Lighting e-shop, September 2024: 36 W 60x60 LED panel at 752-1,040 EGP, about 9-10 m2 of coverage per unit, adjusted down for bulk government procurement to 83 EGP/m2.
notes: Short service life so charged 2.5 replacement cycles over the 30yr horizon

label: Rooftop solar PV
source_ref: Fraunhofer ISE, "Photovoltaics Report" (2024), p.37, citing Friedrich et al. (2020) on global warming potential and energy payback: 1,800 kgCO2e/kWp is the documented average for mono-Si modules manufactured on a high-carbon grid. Installed cost comes from params.solar, not from this row.
notes: cost_type=solar uses params.solar fixed+per_kWp model and the self-consumption cap
